title: Be used to / get used to
note: used to (past habit) vs be used to vs get used to · 4 strands x 12 · 48 items · built to live 2026-08-06 (cloud run 4)

cards.title: used to ≠ be used to ≠ get used to
cards.title_cz: used to ≠ be used to ≠ get used to
cards.body: Three structures share the same three letters and mean completely different things. What follows **to** is the giveaway: a base verb, or a noun / -ing form.
cards.body_cz: Tři konstrukce sdílejí stejná písmena a znamenají úplně něco jiného. Prozradí to, co stojí po **to**: základní tvar, nebo podstatné jméno / -ing.

table.caption: What follows to
rows: I used to live in Prague.
I am used to getting up early.
You will get used to driving on the left.

cards.title: used to = past habit only
cards.body: **used to + base verb** describes something that was true repeatedly in the past and is not true now. It has no present form — for a present habit use the present simple.
cards.body_cz: **used to + základní tvar** popisuje něco, co bylo v minulosti opakovaně pravda a teď už není. Nemá přítomný tvar — pro současný zvyk použijte přítomný prostý.
points: She used to work in a bank. (she does not now)
Question and negative drop the -d: Did you use to play football?
We did not use to have a car.

cards.title: be / get used to take -ing
cards.title_cz: Po be / get used to je -ing
cards.body: Here **to** is a preposition, not an infinitive marker, so a verb after it has to be an -ing form. This is the single most common mistake in the whole unit.
cards.body_cz: Tady je **to** předložka, ne značka infinitivu, takže sloveso po ní musí být v -ing. Tohle je nejčastější chyba v celé lekci.
points: I am used to getting up early. (not: to get up)
He got used to walking to work. (not: to walk)
A noun works too: I am used to the traffic.

cards.title: be = state · get = change
cards.body: **be used to** is where you already are. **get used to** is the journey — it works in every tense, and it is the one you need for "I am still adjusting".
cards.body_cz: **be used to** je stav, ve kterém už jste. **get used to** je cesta k němu — funguje ve všech časech a hodí se na „pořád si zvykám".
points: She is not used to the cold, but she will get used to it.
They are still getting used to their new home.
After a month she was used to the new office.
